newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barges quoted at steady to lower levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barges quoted at steady to lower levels.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted as bids and offers steady to lower on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded on Friday versus none on Thursday. Bids and offers included:
- One barge next week mid-Mississippi River bid at a steady 200 percent of tariff, offered at 210 percent.
- Two barges next week Mississippi River (St. Louis) offered at 170 percent, no bid or comparison.
- Four barges, two each week this week/next week, Mississippi (Dubuque) bid at 195 percent, no offer or comparison.
- One barge, on station, Mississippi (St. Louis) offered at 175 percent, no bid or comparison.
- Two barges, week of November 3, mid-Mississippi (McGregor and south) bid five points lower at 200 percent, no offer.
- Four barges, one each week November, Illinois River, bid 2-1/2 points lower at 170 percent, offered at 172-1/2 percent.
- Eight barges, two each week December, Mississippi (St. Louis) offered at a steady 130 percent, no bid. --Chicago newsdesk 312-408 8720
